title: Crew member
description: How the dashboard shows one eve agent: agents/<name>/crew.json. eve ignores this file.

name.description: Display name in the crew list and chat header.

role.description: One line on what this crew member does.

suggestions.description: Starter prompts shown above the composer.

order.description: Position in the crew list, lowest first; members without one follow, by directory name.

connectors.description: Which connected services this crew member may use, by the name Settings shows for each. Leave it out to allow all of them.

approvals.description: When this crew member asks before changing something in a connected service: always (every time, the default), once (once per chat), auto (a reviewer model decides), or never. Reads and the first call to a new website ask regardless.
